notes: NHS side-effects/common-questions pages were only seen through blended summaries, not page text. Self-harm wording: re-retrieval says contact NHS 111; the site crisis rule (999 if in immediate danger, Samaritans 116 123) could not be sourced from retrieved prednisolone text, so a human may want to add it from a mental-health source. 'Usual timing: once a day in the morning' is NHS wording, not a dose. The medications.json prednisolone entry (key 'prednisolone') was read; its cautions (blue card for >3 weeks, live vaccines, liquorice) are consistent with the article, which gives no thresholds. The NHS 111-vs-A&E/999 self-harm conflict and 'a few weeks vs 2 weeks' duration conflict were resolved by removing figures.
